readinessDomains.name: product-clarity
readinessDomains.evidence: The hidden run has truthful local-session copy and fixed progression.
readinessDomains.gap: Public purpose, audience, naming, entry point, and beta promise are unapproved.
readinessDomains.recommendedAction: Approve a bounded product brief.

readinessDomains.name: content-sufficiency
readinessDomains.evidence: Exactly two human-approved items cover one offensive and one defensive objective.
readinessDomains.gap: Below the proposed five-item, three-objective threshold; repetition is immediate.
readinessDomains.recommendedAction: Author and human-review at least three additional distinct items.

readinessDomains.name: session-length
readinessDomains.evidence: A fixed two-item session is deterministic and compact.
readinessDomains.gap: No public session-length policy or completion research exists.
readinessDomains.recommendedAction: Approve fixed five-item preview policy before public exposure.

readinessDomains.name: objective-diversity
readinessDomains.evidence: Promote and stop-promotion demonstrate two objective contracts.
readinessDomains.gap: No third contract, second offensive item, second defensive item, or distinct conversion item.
readinessDomains.recommendedAction: Meet the proposed diversity floor.

readinessDomains.name: educational-value
readinessDomains.evidence: Each current item has reviewed hints, truthful feedback, and a bounded instructional objective.
readinessDomains.gap: The pair is too small to establish a coherent public learning progression.
readinessDomains.recommendedAction: Review a five-item instructional sequence.

readinessDomains.name: hint-policy
readinessDomains.evidence: Three stages exist and final reveal removes independent eligibility.
readinessDomains.gap: Public wording and reveal-confirmation policy are unapproved.
readinessDomains.recommendedAction: Keep staged hints secondary and approve disclosure copy.

readinessDomains.name: result-semantics
readinessDomains.evidence: Independent, assisted, objective failure, drawing miss, technical unavailable, and abandonment are distinct.
readinessDomains.gap: Internal names require user-facing terminology approval.
readinessDomains.recommendedAction: Approve plain-language public labels.

readinessDomains.name: retry-and-abandonment
readinessDomains.evidence: Retry Item, Retry Run, Exit, and stale ownership are tested.
readinessDomains.gap: No approved exit-confirmation or pause policy.
readinessDomains.recommendedAction: Keep ephemeral retry; approve confirmation rules.

readinessDomains.name: accessibility
readinessDomains.evidence: Automated Axe, keyboard paths, responsive layouts, and focus transitions pass.
readinessDomains.gap: Required human screen-reader, high-contrast, zoom, touch, and device review is unset.
readinessDomains.recommendedAction: Complete the human accessibility plan and resolve failures.

readinessDomains.name: responsive-behavior
readinessDomains.evidence: Automated 320–1920 px matrix passes in three browser engines.
readinessDomains.gap: Physical mobile devices, landscape, safe-area, browser chrome, and orientation changes are unreviewed.
readinessDomains.recommendedAction: Complete physical-device review for preview targets.

readinessDomains.name: privacy
readinessDomains.evidence: The run controller stores no cookies, localStorage, sessionStorage, account IDs, or results; it fetches three static artifacts.
readinessDomains.gap: Hosting request logs, third-party IP processing, retention, and site-level external-script behavior are not established by run code.
readinessDomains.recommendedAction: Complete infrastructure/privacy-owner audit and update notice if needed.

readinessDomains.name: observability
readinessDomains.evidence: No run telemetry, analytics events, or reporting service exists.
readinessDomains.gap: No operational failure-rate signal or approved event/retention policy.
readinessDomains.recommendedAction: Choose no telemetry or minimal privacy-preserving operational events with legal review.

readinessDomains.name: security
readinessDomains.evidence: Exact gates, item allowlists, artifact hashes, stale guards, textContent rendering, and private-path exclusions are tested.
readinessDomains.gap: Public threat-model sign-off and cache/config review remain pending; no high issue is currently evidenced.
readinessDomains.recommendedAction: Perform release threat-model review.

readinessDomains.name: artifact-integrity
readinessDomains.evidence: Run and item artifacts have locked fingerprints and SHA-256 verification.
readinessDomains.gap: Artifacts remain unsigned.
readinessDomains.recommendedAction: Allow unsigned invite-only preview only if approved; require signing decision for beta.

readinessDomains.name: operational-rollback
readinessDomains.evidence: Removing the hidden flag or reverting the deployment returns normal V2 without migration.
readinessDomains.gap: No public runbook, alert threshold, owner roster, or communication template.
readinessDomains.recommendedAction: Approve and rehearse rollback runbook.

readinessDomains.name: kill-switch
readinessDomains.evidence: Current hidden gate fails closed and can be removed by deployment.
readinessDomains.gap: No authenticated rapid server-side disable without redeploy.
readinessDomains.recommendedAction: Add an authenticated edge/environment kill switch with normal V2 fallback before preview.

readinessDomains.name: performance
readinessDomains.evidence: Artifacts total 14,530 bytes; one board and zero Workers are used.
readinessDomains.gap: No formal budgets, physical-device measurements, retry-run memory profile, or cache policy sign-off.
readinessDomains.recommendedAction: Measure against proposed budgets on target devices.

readinessDomains.name: browser-compatibility
readinessDomains.evidence: Chromium, Firefox, and WebKit complete the run locally and in production.
readinessDomains.gap: No physical Edge, Android Chrome, or iOS Safari review; minimum versions unapproved.
readinessDomains.recommendedAction: Approve browser policy and test physical mobile targets.

readinessDomains.name: public-navigation-readiness
readinessDomains.evidence: No navigation or normal Modes exposure exists.
readinessDomains.gap: Entry point and information architecture are unapproved.
readinessDomains.recommendedAction: Keep hidden until tier and entry point receive approval.

readinessDomains.name: support-and-documentation
readinessDomains.evidence: Private architecture and technical QA exist.
readinessDomains.gap: No public help, FAQ, limitations, privacy explanation, or support escalation path.
readinessDomains.recommendedAction: Prepare and approve public support copy before preview.

readinessDomains.name: legal-and-provenance-boundary
readinessDomains.evidence: Reviewed artifacts publish safe contracts while reviewer/evidence materials remain private.
readinessDomains.gap: No legal review of preview terms, telemetry choice, accessibility claims, or support promises.
readinessDomains.recommendedAction: Obtain legal/privacy review without making guarantees.

readinessDomains.name: localization-readiness
readinessDomains.evidence: Current English copy is concise.
readinessDomains.gap: Runtime strings, counts, results, hints, errors, and announcements are hardcoded.
readinessDomains.recommendedAction: Permit English-only invite preview; require extraction and pluralization before broader beta.

readinessDomains.name: public-naming
readinessDomains.evidence: Internal name Endgame Run is compact.
readinessDomains.gap: Potential confusion with Quick Challenge and competitive connotations has not been human-reviewed.
readinessDomains.recommendedAction: Approve Endgame Practice as public candidate and retain technical internal ID.

readinessDomains.name: beta-labeling
readinessDomains.evidence: Current shell says local technical session.
readinessDomains.gap: No approved expectation, limitations, or support copy.
readinessDomains.recommendedAction: Use Limited Preview only after approval; reserve Beta for full gates.

readinessDomains.name: production-support-burden
readinessDomains.evidence: Rollback is technically simple because sessions are ephemeral.
readinessDomains.gap: No ownership, incident severity, response targets, known-issues page, or escalation path.
readinessDomains.recommendedAction: Define support ownership and incident handling.
